name: settings-agent
note: Round 16 (operator: 'add short description/details in the settings menu on new accordion slot AI Agent - with link to details... SSOT for users - points agent apps at URL/uri that's live on the app - transparent to users on how it works'). The section explains the agent surface in plain words, links the LIVE artifacts (AGENTS.md + capabilities.json) resolved from the serving origin, and offers copy buttons for handing the URIs to an agent chat. The SSOT proof is REAL: the scenario fetches the live static AGENTS.md and asserts it byte-equals window.AgentReadme.text() - the one renderer that also feeds the skills-export bundle - and that capabilities.json parses with its schema id. Section order: the Skills panel self-injects ABOVE the agent section (the agent family reads together), About stays last.

steps.label: section ORDER: Skills injects above AI Agent so the agent family reads together, About last

round 18: the section LEADS with the one-tap bundle export (agent instructions + skills + latest data in one zip - the operator's single conversation starter), wired to the same downloadBundle as the Skills row
steps.js: (function(){var row=document.getElementById('agentBundleRow');if(!row)return false;var r=row.getBoundingClientRect();if(!(r.height>=44))return false;if(typeof row.onclick!=='function')return false;var t=row.querySelector('.li-title');if(!t||t.textContent.indexOf('Export agent bundle')<0)return false;var rd=document.getElementById('agentReadmeLink');return !!rd&&r.top<rd.getBoundingClientRect().top;})()

steps.label: the section is transparent and SSOT-shaped: two plain-words hints, both live-doc links resolved to THIS serving origin (/music/agent/...), the URI hint showing the live address, and both copy buttons wired at 44px
steps.js: (function(){var body=document.getElementById('accBodyAgent');if(!body||body.hidden)return false;var hints=body.querySelectorAll('.setHint');if(hints.length<3)return false;if(!(hints[0].textContent.length>60&&hints[1].textContent.length>60))return false;var rd=document.getElementById('agentReadmeLink'),cp=document.getElementById('agentCapsLink');if(!rd||!cp)return false;var o=location.origin;if(rd.href!==o+'/music/agent/AGENTS.md')return false;if(cp.href!==o+'/music/agent/capabilities.json')return false;var hint=document.getElementById('agentUriHint');if(!hint||hint.textContent.indexOf(rd.href)<0)return false;var b1=document.getElementById('agentCopyLinks'),b2=document.getElementById('agentCopyPrompt');if(!b1||!b2)return false;if(typeof b1.onclick!=='function'||typeof b2.onclick!=='function')return false;var r1=b1.getBoundingClientRect(),r2=b2.getBoundingClientRect();return r1.height>=44&&r2.height>=44;})()
